thirdHearth.name: The Third Hearth
thirdHearth.epigram: Three fires, and the road between them.

firstLight.name: First Light of the Æra
firstLight.epigram: Somebody has to be first into the new century.
firstLight.text: You are the first empire in the world to enter a new era.

marvelRaised.name: A Marvel Raised
marvelRaised.epigram: The scaffolding comes down and the thing is simply there.

againstTheOdds.name: Against the Odds
againstTheOdds.epigram: The stronger army lost, and everyone counted again.
againstTheOdds.text: You win a battle against a defender stronger than the unit you attacked with.

campBurned.name: The Camp Burned
campBurned.epigram: The smoke went up and the road was quiet after.

ruinRead.name: A Ruin Read
ruinRead.epigram: Somebody else's answer, left where it fell.
ruinRead.text: You claim a ruin or a village.

writExtends.name: The Writ Extends
writExtends.epigram: New seals, new hands, the same tax.

godNamed.name: A God Named
godNamed.epigram: You say the name and the name says you.
godNamed.text: You consecrate a god into your pantheon.

greatCity.name: The Great City
greatCity.epigram: Ten thousand strangers who all live here.
greatCity.text: One of your cities reaches ten citizens.

farShore.name: The Far Shore
farShore.epigram: The other side of the water has a name now.
farShore.text: You found a city on a landmass you did not start on.

theTaken.name: The Taken
theTaken.epigram: The gates open the way they were built to.
theTaken.text: You take a city by force.

fallenBecomeVerse.name: The Fallen Become Verse
fallenBecomeVerse.epigram: The song is longer than the battle was.
fallenBecomeVerse.text: You win a battle after losing a unit in it.
fallenBecomeVerse.deferred: A unit lost in a battle you then win — combat carries no memory of the exchange, and the line waits on Epic Poetry.

longRoad.name: The Long Road
longRoad.epigram: Two towns and a week between them, now three days.
longRoad.text: You join two of your cities by road.
longRoad.deferred: Two cities connected by road — there are no roads and no connections yet.

eightLuxuries.name: The Eight Luxuries
eightLuxuries.epigram: Eight things nobody needs and everybody wants.
eightLuxuries.text: You hold eight different luxuries, each dug out by an improvement.

tenHearths.name: The Ten Hearths
tenHearths.epigram: A map with your colour on it in ten places.

firstKeel.name: The First Keel
firstKeel.epigram: It floats, which was the whole question.
firstKeel.text: You build your first naval unit.
firstKeel.deferred: Your first naval unit — there are no naval units; Sailing embarks civilians only.

cityOfMarvels.name: The City of Marvels
cityOfMarvels.epigram: Seven of them, and the eighth is the skyline.
cityOfMarvels.text: One of your cities holds seven wonders.
